container_info.description:
The Knowledge Bot is an AI-powered chatbot system designed to answer user queries based on a curated context of sample questions and answers. The system features a modern web-based interface, robust backend integration with Google Gemini for live AI responses, and comprehensive error handling and logging. It is intended to provide authoritative, context-aware answers for software testing and related domains, supporting both end users and internal teams.

Key features include:
- Modern chat UI for seamless user interaction
- Real-time AI-powered responses using Google Gemini
- Context injection from curated Q&A datasets
- RESTful API endpoints for chat and answer retrieval
- Comprehensive error handling, logging, and monitoring
- Responsive design and accessibility compliance
- Secure integration and privacy controls
- OpenAPI documentation for backend endpoints
- Scalable architecture for future enhancements

steps.name: Environment setup and global persistence
steps.description: Create workspace, validate node/npm versions, write a safe /etc/profile.d script that only exports NODE_ENV and performs a runtime-safe npm global-bin PATH augmentation (checks command -v npm and npm bin -g at shell-login time). Log key tool versions (node, npm, create-react-app, eslint, prettier) to /tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt and set safe permissions. Do not embed current interactive $PATH into profile.d. Validate created profile script can be sourced.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
sudo mkdir -p "$WORKDIR" "$WORKDIR/.config" && sudo chown -R "$USER":"$USER" "$WORKDIR"
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo 'node missing' >&2; exit 2; }
NODE_VER=$(node -v)
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_VER" | sed 's/^v//' | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then echo "node $NODE_VER unsupported (>=16 required)" >&2; exit 3; fi
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo 'npm missing' >&2; exit 4; }
NPM_VER=$(npm --version)
# Write safe profile.d script: runtime checks, avoids embedding current $PATH
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/frontend_node.sh
sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Frontend development environment (runtime-safe)
export NODE_ENV=development
# If npm is available at login, prepend npm global bin to PATH when it exists
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPM_GLOB_BIN="$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/bin)"
  if [ -d "$NPM_GLOB_BIN" ] && ! echo ":$PATH:" | grep -q ":$NPM_GLOB_BIN:" ; then
    export PATH="$NPM_GLOB_BIN:$PATH"
  fi
fi
EOF
sudo chmod 0644 "$PROFILE"
# Log versions to /tmp and include create-react-app, eslint, prettier if available
VERS_FILE=/tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt
echo "NODE=$NODE_VER" > "$VERS_FILE"
echo "NPM=$NPM_VER" >> "$VERS_FILE"
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then CRA_VER=$(create-react-app --version 2>/dev/null || true); echo "CREATE_REACT_APP=$CRA_VER" >> "$VERS_FILE"; else CRA_VER=""; fi
if command -v eslint >/dev/null 2>&1; then ESLINT_VER=$(eslint --version 2>/dev/null || true); echo "ESLINT=$ESLINT_VER" >> "$VERS_FILE"; fi
if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then PRETTIER_VER=$(prettier --version 2>/dev/null || true); echo "PRETTIER=$PRETTIER_VER" >> "$VERS_FILE"; fi
sudo chmod 0644 "$VERS_FILE"
# Validate profile can be sourced without error
bash -c "source /etc/profile.d/frontend_node.sh" || { echo 'sourcing profile failed' >&2; exit 5; }

steps.name: Scaffold minimal React app with CRA (JavaScript)
steps.description: Detect an existing CRA app robustly (checks package.json react-scripts in dependencies or devDependencies, and common CRA files). If absent and workspace empty (or CLEAN_WORKSPACE=1), scaffold with a validated global create-react-app if >=5 else fallback to npx create-react-app@latest --use-npm. Write minimal .env and .gitignore. Log create-react-app version to /tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/.../Frontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
cd "$WORKDIR"
# Robust CRA detection using node for correct logical grouping
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try{const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')); if((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['react-scripts'])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['react-scripts'])) process.exit(0);}catch(e){} process.exit(1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo 'CRA detected via package.json'; exit 0; }
fi
# also check common CRA files
if [ -f public/index.html ] || compgen -G "src/index.*" >/dev/null; then echo 'CRA-like files present'; exit 0; fi
# Abort if non-empty unless CLEAN_WORKSPACE=1
if [ "$(ls -A | wc -l)" -gt 0 ] && [ "${CLEAN_WORKSPACE:-0}" != "1" ]; then echo 'workspace non-empty and not a CRA project; aborting scaffold. To force scaffold set CLEAN_WORKSPACE=1' >&2; exit 6; fi
# Determine CRA usage: prefer global if semver >=5
USE_LOCAL_CRA=0
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # try to get semver via npm if create-react-app binary version is unreliable
  CRA_VER="$(create-react-app --version 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -z "$CRA_VER" ]; then CRA_VER="$(npm view create-react-app version 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
  if [ -n "$CRA_VER" ]; then CRA_MAJOR=$(echo "$CRA_VER" | sed -E 's/^([0-9]+).*/\1/'); if [ "$CRA_MAJOR" -ge 5 ] 2>/dev/null; then USE_LOCAL_CRA=1; fi; fi
fi
# Run scaffold
if [ "$USE_LOCAL_CRA" -eq 1 ]; then
  create-react-app . --use-npm --silent >/tmp/cra_create.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 /tmp/cra_create.log; echo 'create-react-app failed' >&2; exit 7; }
else
  env HUSKY=0 npx --yes --timeout=120000 create-react-app@latest . --use-npm >/tmp/cra_create.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 /tmp/cra_create.log; echo 'npx create-react-app failed' >&2; exit 8; }
fi
# Post-create: ensure react/react-dom/react-scripts exist
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')); if(!(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react&&p.dependencies['react-dom']&&((p.dependencies['react-scripts'])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['react-scripts'])))) process.exit(1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'CRA scaffold failed to produce required deps' >&2; exit 9; }
# Write .env and .gitignore
cat > "$WORKDIR/.env" <<'EOF'
REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080/api
REACT_APP_GOOGLE_GEMINI_KEY=replace_with_key
EOF
cat > "$WORKDIR/.gitignore" <<'EOF'
node_modules/
build/
.env
EOF
# Log CRA version to versions file
if [ -f /tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt ]; then echo "CRA_USED=$CRA_VER" >> /tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt; fi

steps.name: Validation: build, start headless dev server, check health, stop
steps.description: Build the app (npm run build) to validate production bundling, then start the CRA dev server headless, detect the actual server process listening on the PORT, probe localhost for readiness, and stop the real server processes reliably (pkill or kill by listening PID). Capture build and start logs to /tmp with 0644 permissions and provide evidence (PID(s) and recent logs).
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
cd "$WORKDIR"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'package.json missing' >&2; exit 18; }
# Verify react-scripts present
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')); if(!((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['react-scripts'])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['react-scripts']))) process.exit(1);" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'react-scripts missing; run deps step' >&2; exit 19; }
# Build production bundle
BUILD_LOG=/tmp/npm-build.log; : > "$BUILD_LOG"; chmod 0644 "$BUILD_LOG"
npm run build --silent >"$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || { echo 'build failed' >&2; tail -n 200 "$BUILD_LOG" || true; exit 20; }
# Start dev server headless
START_LOG=/tmp/cra_start.log; : > "$START_LOG"; chmod 0644 "$START_LOG"
PORT=3000
HOST=0.0.0.0
# start in background, allow wrapper but later find listening process
HOST="$HOST" PORT="$PORT" BROWSER=none nohup npm start >"$START_LOG" 2>&1 &
STARTER_PID=$!
sleep 1
# Wait for server to bind to PORT
RETRIES=60; COUNT=0; UP=0
while [ $COUNT -lt $RETRIES ]; do
  # detect any process listening on PORT
  if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    L=$(ss -ltnp "sport = :$PORT" 2>/dev/null || true)
  else
    L=$(netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ":$PORT" || true)
  fi
  if [ -n "$L" ]; then UP=1; break; fi
  sleep 1; COUNT=$((COUNT+1))
done
if [ $UP -ne 1 ]; then echo "dev server not listening on port $PORT after $RETRIES seconds" >&2; tail -n 200 "$START_LOG" || true; # attempt cleanup
  pkill -P "$STARTER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$STARTER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; pkill -9 -f "react-scripts" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 21
fi
# Find the node process(es) actually serving PORT
PIDS=()
if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  while read -r pid; do PIDS+=("$pid"); done < <(lsof -iTCP:"$PORT" -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null || true)
else
  # fallback using ss/netstat parsing to extract pid
  if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PIDS_RAW=$(ss -ltnp "sport = :$PORT" 2>/dev/null | awk -F"," '/users:/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i~/pid=/) {gsub(/[^0-9]/,"", $i); print $i}}' || true)
    for p in $PIDS_RAW; do PIDS+=("$p"); done
  else
    PIDS_RAW=$(netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ":$PORT" | awk -F"/" '{print $1}' | awk '{print $7}' | sed -E 's/[^0-9]//g' || true)
    for p in $PIDS_RAW; do [ -n "$p" ] && PIDS+=("$p"); done
  fi
fi
# Deduplicate
if [ ${#PIDS[@]} -eq 0 ]; then # fallback to starter PID
  PIDS=("$STARTER_PID")
fi
echo "DEV_SERVER_PIDS=${PIDS[*]}"
# Probe HTTP (try localhost and 127.0.0.1)
PROBED=0
for host in 127.0.0.1 localhost; do
  if curl -sS --max-time 2 "http://$host:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then PROBED=1; break; fi
done
if [ $PROBED -ne 1 ]; then echo 'dev server not responding to HTTP probe' >&2; tail -n 200 "$START_LOG" || true; fi
# Show recent logs for evidence
tail -n 100 "$START_LOG" || true
# Stop server processes reliably
for p in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
  kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
sleep 1
for p in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
  if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
done
# ensure wrapper is gone
kill "$STARTER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$STARTER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'validation completed'

# Build production bundle
BUILD_LOG=/tmp/npm-build.log; : > "$BUILD_LOG"; chmod 0644 "$BUILD_LOG"
npm run build --silent >"$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || { echo 'build failed' >&2; tail -n 200 "$BUILD_LOG" || true; exit 20; }
# Start dev server headless
START_LOG=/tmp/cra_start.log; : > "$START_LOG"; chmod 0644 "$START_LOG"
PORT=3000
HOST=0.0.0.0
# start in background; set BROWSER=none to prevent opening
HOST="$HOST" PORT="$PORT" BROWSER=none nohup npm start >"$START_LOG" 2>&1 &
STARTER_PID=$!
sleep 1
# Wait for server to bind to PORT
RETRIES=60; COUNT=0; UP=0
while [ $COUNT -lt $RETRIES ]; do
  if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    L=$(ss -ltnp "sport = :$PORT" 2>/dev/null || true)
  else
    L=$(netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ":$PORT" || true)
  fi
  if [ -n "$L" ]; then UP=1; break; fi
  sleep 1; COUNT=$((COUNT+1))
done
if [ $UP -ne 1 ]; then echo "dev server not listening on port $PORT after $RETRIES seconds" >&2; tail -n 200 "$START_LOG" || true; # attempt cleanup
  pkill -P "$STARTER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$STARTER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; pkill -9 -f "react-scripts" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 21
fi
# Find the node process(es) actually serving PORT
PIDS=()
if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  while read -r pid; do PIDS+=("$pid"); done < <(lsof -iTCP:"$PORT" -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null || true)
else
  if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PIDS_RAW=$(ss -ltnp "sport = :$PORT" 2>/dev/null | awk -F"," '/users:/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i~/pid=/) {gsub(/[^0-9]/,"", $i); print $i}}' || true)
    for p in $PIDS_RAW; do PIDS+=("$p"); done
  else
    PIDS_RAW=$(netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ":$PORT" | awk -F"/" '{print $1}' | awk '{print $7}' | sed -E 's/[^0-9]//g' || true)
    for p in $PIDS_RAW; do [ -n "$p" ] && PIDS+=("$p"); done
  fi
fi
# Deduplicate
if [ ${#PIDS[@]} -eq 0 ]; then # fallback to starter PID
  PIDS=("$STARTER_PID")
fi
# Print PID evidence
echo "DEV_SERVER_PIDS=${PIDS[*]}"
# Probe HTTP (try localhost and 127.0.0.1)
PROBED=0
for host in 127.0.0.1 localhost; do
  if curl -sS --max-time 2 "http://$host:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then PROBED=1; break; fi
done
if [ $PROBED -ne 1 ]; then echo 'dev server not responding to HTTP probe' >&2; tail -n 200 "$START_LOG" || true; fi
# Show recent logs for evidence
echo "--- recent start log (tail -n 100) ---"
tail -n 100 "$START_LOG" || true
# Stop server processes reliably
for p in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
  kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
sleep 1
for p in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
  if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
done
# ensure wrapper is gone
kill "$STARTER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$STARTER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'validation completed'
